fixed_skill.desc:
Increase 1 foe's damage taken by 16.0%/16.8%/17.6% and inflict 1 Serpent's Venom stack for 3 turns.
Serpent's Venom: Every turn, take Curse damage equal to 12.8%/13.4%/14.1% of the Attack of the Phantom Thief with the highest Attack (this ally's Attack is counted up to a maximum of 300% of Wonder's Attack). Stacks up to 2 times.
fixed_skill.name: Venomous Spiral

innate_skill.desc: Decrease this skill's accuracy by 15%, increase critical rate by 16%, and deal Gun damage to all foes equal to 14.9/15.6/16.4% of Attack (3 hits).
innate_skill.name: Triple Down

innate_skill.desc: Deal Bless damage to all foes equal to 45.0/49.3/53.6% of Attack. Low chance to deal a Bless insta-kill effect to foes with 50% or less HP. Increase chance based on foe's missing HP.
innate_skill.name: Mahamaon

innate_skill.desc: Increase critical rate of ranged attacks by 8.9%.
innate_skill.name: Trigger Happy IV

passive_skill.desc:
Increase ailment accuracy by 34.9%.
At the start of battle, gain 3 Bitter Stagnation stacks. Whenever allies inflict debuffs with skills, gain 1 Bitter Stagnation stack (up to 1 stack per turn). This effect stacks up to 5 times. Activates even when in reserve.
Bitter Stagnation: After a skill is used, spend 5 stacks to increase the main target's damage taken from newly inflicted continuous damage by 10% for 3 turns.
passive_skill.name: Serpent's Turmoil
